## Overview

**TROPICS** (Time-Resolved Observations of Precipitation structure and storm
Intensity with a Constellation of Smallsats) is a NASA Earth Venture-Instrument
mission.
The **TMS** (TROPICS Microwave Sounder) is a 12-channel passive microwave
radiometer spanning ~90–205 GHz aboard a constellation of CubeSats
(TMS-02 through TMS-07), designed to measure precipitation and atmospheric
temperature structure in tropical cyclones with rapid revisit times.

The S3 bucket at `s3://airborne-smce-prod-user-bucket/JOIN/TMS/` holds
multiple processing levels for satellites TMS-02 (Tomorrow-S02) and TMS-09
(Tomorrow-S09), plus a merged 2025 archive (`1C-TCP_ALL`) covering six
satellites.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Satellites | TMS-02 – TMS-07, TMS-09 (Tomorrow-S series) |
| Agency | NASA |
| Instrument | TROPICS Microwave Sounder (TMS) |
| Channels | 12 (90–205 GHz) |
| Spots per scan | 81 (native) or 128 (regridded) |
| Data format | NetCDF-4 (flat; no groups) |
| S3 bucket | `s3://airborne-smce-prod-user-bucket/JOIN/TMS/` |
| Date range (TS02/TS09) | 2026-02-08 – 2026-02-19 |
| Date range (1C-TCP_ALL) | 2025-01-01 – 2025-12-31 |
| Total files | ~161 000+ |
| Approx. total size | ~234 GB |

---

## S3 bucket organisation

The bucket contains nine top-level product prefixes:

```
s3://airborne-smce-prod-user-bucket/JOIN/TMS/
  TS02_L1B-TB/       ← TMS-02 L1B brightness temperatures (native)
  TS02_L1B-TBR/      ← TMS-02 L1B resampled to ch10 boresight grid
  TS02_L1C-TC/       ← TMS-02 L1C intercalibrated TBs
  TS02_L1C-TCR/      ← TMS-02 L1C intercalibrated + regridded (equal spacing)
  TS09_L1B-TB/       ← TMS-09 L1B brightness temperatures (native)
  TS09_L1B-TBR/      ← TMS-09 L1B resampled
  TS09_L1C-TC/       ← TMS-09 L1C intercalibrated TBs
  TS09_L1C-TCR/      ← TMS-09 L1C intercalibrated + regridded
  1C-TCP_ALL/        ← All-satellite 2025 L1C archive (TMS-02–07)
```

### `TS02_*` and `TS09_*` directories

Files are arranged under a flat `{YYYYMMDD}/` date directory:

```
TS02_L1B-TB/
  20260216/
  20260217/
  …
  20260219/    ← ~36 granules/day (TS02) or ~100 granules/day (TS09)
```

Each granule is one ~2-minute orbit segment.

### `1C-TCP_ALL`

Uses a deeper `Y{YYYY}/M{MM}/D{DD}/` hierarchy and covers all of 2025:

```
1C-TCP_ALL/
  Y2025/
    M01/ – M12/
      D01/ – D31/
        ← ~36 granules/day × 6 satellites × two product types (1C-TC + 1C-TCR)
```

---

## File naming convention

All TMS files follow the same template:

```
TMS{sat}.{level}-{product}.V{version}.NRT.ST{start_ts}.ET{end_ts}.CT{create_ts}.nc
```

### Example

```
TMS02.1B-TB.V01-00.NRT.ST20260219-001118.ET20260219-002312.CT20260219-220644.nc
```

| Field | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `TMS02` | — | Satellite identifier (02–07, 09) |
| `1B-TB` | — | Processing level and product type |
| `V01-00` | — | Product version |
| `NRT` | — | Processing mode: Near-Real-Time |
| `ST20260219-001118` | — | Scene start time: 2026-02-19 00:11:18 UTC |
| `ET20260219-002312` | — | Scene end time: 2026-02-19 00:23:12 UTC |
| `CT20260219-220644` | — | File creation time: 2026-02-19 22:06:44 UTC |

Product type codes:

| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| `1B-TB` | L1B brightness temperatures (native boresight) |
| `1B-TBR` | L1B brightness temperatures resampled to channel 10 boresight |
| `1C-TC` | L1C intercalibrated brightness temperatures |
| `1C-TCR` | L1C intercalibrated + regridded to equal-spacing (14.31 km) |
| `1C-TCP` | L1C intercalibrated (used in the merged 1C-TCP_ALL archive) |

---

## Product hierarchy

The four product levels build on each other in a processing chain:

```
L1B-TB  →  L1B-TBR  →  L1C-TC  →  L1C-TCR
 (raw)   (resampled)  (xcal)    (gridded + limb-adjusted)
```

All products share the same spacecraft navigation, geometry, and flag
variables.
The science variable (`brightness_temperature`) is refined at each step.

---

## File contents

### Shared dimensions (all products)

| Dimension | Size | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `scans` | ~357–412 | Number of scan lines per granule |
| `spots` | 81 | Cross-track FOVs per scan (native products) |
| `channels` | 12 | Spectral channels |
| `cal_spots` | 10 | Calibration sector spots |
| `across_track_grid` | 128 | Equal-spaced grid width (TCR products only) |

### Shared variables: spacecraft navigation

Present in all four product types with shapes referenced to `(scans,)` or
`(spots, scans)`.

| Variable | Shape | Dtype | Description | Units |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Year/Month/Day` | (scans,) | uint8/uint16 | UTC date components of scan | — |
| `Hour/Minute/Second/Millisecond` | (scans,) | uint8/uint16 | UTC time components of scan | — |
| `scLatitude` | (scans,) | float32 | Sub-satellite latitude | degrees_north |
| `scLongitude` | (scans,) | float32 | Sub-satellite longitude | degrees_east |
| `scAltitude` | (scans,) | float32 | Spacecraft altitude above WGS84 | km |
| `scPosECEF` | (scans, 3) | float32 | Spacecraft ECEF position [x, y, z] | km |
| `scVelECEF` | (scans, 3) | float32 | Spacecraft ECEF velocity [x, y, z] | km/s |
| `scQuatECEF` | (scans, 4) | float32 | Body-to-ECEF quaternion [i, j, k, r] | — |
| `scRollAngle` | (scans,) | float32 | Spacecraft roll angle | degrees |
| `solar_beta_angle` | (scans,) | float32 | Satellite–sun vector angle from orbital plane | degrees |
| `instrTemp` | (6, scans) | float32 | Average instrument temperatures (6 sensors) | °C |

### Shared variables: per-FOV geometry and flags

Present in L1B-TB, L1B-TBR, and L1C-TC (2D: spots × scans, or 3D including channels).

| Variable | Shape | Dtype | Description | Units |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `latitude` | (spots, scans) or (spots, scans, channels) | float32 | FOV geodetic latitude | degrees_north |
| `longitude` | (spots, scans) or (spots, scans, channels) | float32 | FOV geodetic longitude | degrees_east |
| `elevation` | (spots, scans, channels) | float32 | Surface elevation (antenna-weighted) | m |
| `land_fraction` | (spots, scans, channels) | float32 | Land fraction (antenna-pattern weighted) | — |
| `clear_fraction` | (spots, scans, channels) | float32 | Cloud-clear fraction from geo cloud mask | — |
| `sensor_view_angle` | (spots, scans) or (spots, scans, channels) | float32 | LOS scan angle from nadir | degrees |
| `sensor_zenith_angle` | (spots, scans) | float32 | LOS zenith angle at surface | degrees |
| `sensor_azimuth_angle` | (spots, scans) | float32 | LOS azimuth angle at surface | degrees |
| `solar_zenith_angle` | (spots, scans, channels) | float32 | Solar zenith angle at surface | degrees |
| `solar_azimuth_angle` | (spots, scans, channels) | float32 | Solar azimuth angle at surface | degrees |
| `lunar_zenith_angle` | (spots, scans, channels) | float32 | Lunar zenith angle at surface | degrees |
| `lunar_azimuth_angle` | (spots, scans, channels) | float32 | Lunar azimuth angle at surface | degrees |
| `flagNonOcean` | (spots, scans, channels) | uint8 | Non-ocean flag (0=ocean, 1=land/coast) | — |
| `flagAscDesc` | (spots, scans, channels) | uint8 | Orbit direction: 0=ascending, 1=descending | — |
| `flagDayNight` | (spots, scans, channels) | uint8 | Day/night flag: 0=day, 1=night | — |
| `flagLunarIntrusion` | (spots, scans, channels) | uint8 | Lunar intrusion into calibration sector | — |
| `flagSolarIntrusion` | (spots, scans, channels) | uint8 | Solar intrusion into calibration sector | — |
| `flagManeuver` | (spots, scans, channels) | uint8 | Spacecraft maneuver active | — |
| `flagPLOrientation` | (spots, scans, channels) | uint8 | Payload orientation: 0=forward, 1=aft | — |
| `NumGPSSats` | (spots, scans) | uint8 | Number of GPS satellites tracked | — |
| `StarTrackerStatus` | (spots, scans) | uint8 | Star tracker status (0=OK, 1=Pending, 2=Bad, 3=Few stars) | — |
| `AttitudeErrorDeg` | (spots, scans) | float32 | Estimated attitude error magnitude | degrees |
| `MultiMask` | (spots, scans) | uint8 | Land/cloud mask (1=clear land, 2=cloudy ocean, 3=clear ocean, 4=cloudy land) | — |

### Shared variables: calibration diagnostics

Present in all products.

| Variable | Shape | Dtype | Description | Units |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cold_target_counts` | (scans, channels) | float32 | Mean deep space calibration counts | DN |
| `noise_diode_counts` | (scans, channels) | float32 | Mean noise diode calibration counts | DN |
| `internal_cal_target_counts` | (scans, channels) | float32 | Mean ICT calibration counts | DN |
| `NEDT_DS` | (scans, channels) | float32 | NEDT from deep space (cold) calibration | K |
| `NEDT_ND` | (scans, channels) | float32 | NEDT from noise diode calibration | K |

### L1B-TB — Raw brightness temperatures

Primary science variable and fields unique to this product level:

| Variable | Shape | Dtype | Description | Units |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **`brightness_temperature`** | (spots, scans, channels) | float32 | Antenna-corrected TOA brightness temperature | K [0–350] |
| `antenna_temperature_ND` | (spots, scans, channels) | float32 | Antenna temperature using noise diode as warm cal | K [0–350] |
| `antenna_temperature_ICT` | (spots, scans, channels) | float32 | Antenna temperature using ICT as warm cal | K [0–350] |
| `time` | (spots, scans, 2) | float64 | TROPICS epoch time of earth measurements (TAI seconds since 2000-01-01) | s |
| `encoder_angle` | (spots, scans, 2) | float32 | Scanner encoder angle (0°=nadir) | degrees |
| `encAngleEarthLimb` | (scans, channels) | float32 | Expected encoder angle of Earth limb | degrees |
| `encAngleMaxDNGradient` | (scans, channels) | float32 | Encoder angle of max DN gradient near limb | degrees |
| `flagICT_ND_Consistency` | (spots, scans, channels) | uint8 | ICT–ND consistency flag (0–3) | — |
| `flagOutlierTimestamp` | (spots, scans, 2) | uint8 | Outlier timestamp flag | — |
| `flagSDRTX` | (spots, scans, 2) | uint8 | SDR in transmit mode flag | — |
| `flagColdCal` | (cal_spots, scans, channels) | uint8 | Cold space calibration outlier flag | — |
| `flagNDCal` | (cal_spots, scans, channels) | uint8 | Noise diode calibration outlier flag | — |
| `flagICTCal` | (cal_spots, scans, channels) | uint8 | ICT calibration outlier flag | — |

### L1B-TBR — Resampled brightness temperatures

All TBs and geometry resampled to the **channel 10 (G3) boresight** grid,
removing the channel dimension from lat/lon and most geometry variables.
Adds an RFI flag and a combined quality flag not present in L1B-TB:

| Variable | Shape | Dtype | Description | Units |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **`brightness_temperature`** | (spots, scans, channels) | float32 | TB resampled to ch10 boresight | K [0–350] |
| `latitude` | (spots, scans) | float32 | Latitude at ch10 boresight | degrees_north |
| `longitude` | (spots, scans) | float32 | Longitude at ch10 boresight | degrees_east |
| `flagRFI` | (spots, scans, channels) | uint8 | Radio frequency interference flag | — |
| `combinedQualityFlag` | (spots, scans, channels) | uint16 | 15-bit combined quality flag | — |

---

### L1C-TC — Intercalibrated brightness temperatures

Intercalibrated relative to the TMS-S1 reference satellite using a
neural-network-based cross-calibration model.
Replaces `brightness_temperature` with the intercalibrated variable and adds
an uncertainty estimate:

| Variable | Shape | Dtype | Description | Units |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **`brightness_temperature_xcal`** | (spots, scans, channels) | float32 | Intercalibrated TB (adjusted to TMS-S1 spectral response) | K [0–350] |
| **`xcal_std`** | (spots, scans, channels) | float32 | Intercalibration 1-sigma uncertainty | K [0–20] |

All flags, geometry, calibration diagnostics, and spacecraft navigation
variables are carried over from L1B-TBR unchanged.

---

### L1C-TCR — Intercalibrated and regridded brightness temperatures

TBs regridded to a **uniform 14.31 km equal-spaced cross-track grid**
(128 points).
Provides limb-adjusted variants for improved radiance consistency at large
scan angles.
This product uses `across_track_grid` (128) instead of `spots` (81) for
science variables, and spacecraft navigation reduces to per-scan scalars.

| Variable | Shape | Dtype | Description | Units |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **`brightness_temperature_gridded`** | (128, scans, channels) | float32 | TB on equal-spaced grid | K [0–350] |
| **`brightness_temperature_xcal_gridded`** | (128, scans, channels) | float32 | Intercalibrated TB on equal-spaced grid | K [0–350] |
| **`brightness_temperature_limb`** | (128, scans, channels) | float32 | Gridded TB with limb adjustment | K [0–350] |
| **`brightness_temperature_xcal_limb`** | (128, scans, channels) | float32 | Gridded intercalibrated TB with limb adjustment | K [0–350] |
| `latitude` | (128, scans) | float32 | Latitude on equal-spaced grid | degrees |
| `longitude` | (128, scans) | float32 | Longitude on equal-spaced grid | degrees |
| `scan_angle` | (128, scans) | float32 | Sensor scan angle on equal-spaced grid | degrees |
| `zenith_angle` | (128, scans) | float32 | Sensor zenith angle on grid | degrees |
| `azimuth_angle` | (128, scans) | float32 | Sensor azimuth angle on grid | degrees |
| `land_fraction` | (128, scans) | float32 | Land fraction at W-band resolution | — |
| `elevation` | (128, scans) | float32 | Surface elevation at W-band on grid | m |

---

### `1C-TCP_ALL` — Merged 2025 L1C archive

Contains L1C-TC and L1C-TCR files (see above) for **six TMS satellites**
(TMS-02 through TMS-07) covering the full calendar year 2025.
Variable structure is identical to the per-satellite L1C-TC/TCR products
described above.
The primary difference from the 2026 near-real-time products is the
cross-calibration model version (`V00-05`, an earlier approach referencing
TMS-SN01 rather than the ideal spectral response).

Files in `1C-TCP_ALL` are organised under `Y{YYYY}/M{MM}/D{DD}/`, covering
both `1C-TC` and `1C-TCR` product types for all six constellation members.

---

## Opening files with Python

All TMS files are standard flat NetCDF-4 and can be opened directly:

```python
import xarray as xr

# L1B-TB, L1B-TBR, L1C-TC — native (81 spots) products
ds = xr.open_dataset(
    "TMS02.1C-TC.V01-00.NRT.ST20260219-001118.ET20260219-002312.CT20260219-220644.nc"
)
print(ds["brightness_temperature_xcal"])   # (81, scans, 12)

# L1C-TCR — regridded (128 grid points) product
ds_r = xr.open_dataset(
    "TMS02.1C-TCR.V01-00.NRT.ST20260219-001118.ET20260219-002312.CT20260219-220644.nc"
)
print(ds_r["brightness_temperature_xcal_gridded"])  # (128, scans, 12)
```

To read directly from S3 using obstore:

```python
import io
import xarray as xr
import obstore
from obstore.store import S3Store

S3_BUCKET = "airborne-smce-prod-user-bucket"
S3_REGION = "us-west-2"
S3_PREFIX = "JOIN/TMS/TS02_L1C-TC/20260219"

store = S3Store.from_url(f"s3://{S3_BUCKET}/", region=S3_REGION)

# List granules for a date
files = [obj["key"] for obj in obstore.list(store, prefix=f"{S3_PREFIX}/").collect()]

# Open one granule
raw = bytes(obstore.get(store, files[0]).bytes())
ds = xr.open_dataset(io.BytesIO(raw))
print(ds)
```
